methodology.purpose: Rank underdogs relative to comparable current spread bands using governed dossier evidence and existing model disagreement without changing production pricing.

routing.intermediate: all other current underdogs; calibration only

validationPlan: compare outright win rate to market-implied probability within price buckets
track Brier/log loss when executable ML exists
promote no component into production without holdout validation
